notes: Six identical LED+resistor channels are written out explicitly (not as a repeat) because each lands in different breadboard columns (7/8, 10/11, 13/14, 16/17, 19/20, 22/23) and on different Uno pins (7,6,5,4,3,2).
Breadboard naming follows the image labels: the image's upper half (rows f-j) is bank 'b' and the lower half (rows a-e) is bank 't'. Resistors bridge the centre gap (row f to row e).
LED anode assumed on the left (longer, bent) leg, cathode on the right leg; the short black jumper from each cathode column goes to the top negative rail (tn).
Exact rail hole numbers (tn.N) are approximate from the picture; the whole tn rail is one strip so this is electrically equivalent.
The ground wire goes from the Uno GND pin next to AREF (modelled as GND.1) to the negative rail.
Resistors are 220 ohm per the manual and schematic; LEDs are red per the image.
